description: Source code implementing a Solaris/illumos backend for fsnotify, handling file system events via Unix event ports, including adding/removing watches, event processing, and directory management.

classes.name: fen
classes.description: Backend implementation for Solaris/illumos using Unix event ports, managing watched directories and files, processing events, and handling synchronization.

methods.name: newBackend
methods.description: Creates a new backend instance, initializes Unix event port, and starts event reading goroutine.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the backend, releasing resources and closing the event port.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a file or directory to be watched.

methods.name: AddWith
methods.description: Adds a file or directory with specific options to be watched.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a watched file or directory.

methods.name: WatchList
methods.description: Returns a list of all currently watched paths.
